user.title: Select camera
user.description: Pick the camera that sees the spot where your waste bins stand.

area.title: Region of interest
area.description: The image region where bins can stand, as relative coordinates (0 to 1). Start generous: x/y is the top-left corner, w/h the size. The analysis width controls the internal resolution.

menu_options.reconf_area: Change region of interest / working width

reconf_camera.title: Change camera
reconf_camera.description: All training data is kept. Answer the view question honestly: if the new camera shows a different field of view, old geometry evidence must not mix with new frames.

data.view_unchanged: Same mounting and identical field of view

reconf_view_changed.title: Camera re-aimed
reconf_view_changed.description: Marks the scene mapping as changed (for example after the camera was bumped and could not be re-aligned exactly). All stored evidence is kept; area evidence from the old view goes dormant, color samples stay active. Label a few fresh snapshots afterwards.

reconf_area.title: Change region of interest
reconf_area.description: Sample rectangles are stored relative to the full frame and survive this change. Labels made under a smaller region stay usable when the region grows; after shrinking or moving it, check the relearn warnings for set-aside labels.

reconf_add_bin.title: Add a bin
reconf_add_bin.description: The new bin appears as a sensor but stays unavailable until you draw lid samples and relearn. Other bins keep working meanwhile.

reconf_retire_bin.title: Retire a bin
reconf_retire_bin.description: The bin's sensor entity is removed - check automations that use it. ALL its training data is kept and comes back on reactivation.

reconf_reactivate_bin.title: Reactivate a bin
reconf_reactivate_bin.description: The bin returns with its full training history. If its lid color changed since retirement, call the mark_bin_appearance_changed service afterwards for a fresh color start (history is kept dormant).

error.invalid_roi: The region must lie inside the image (x+w and y+h at most 1, sizes above 0).
error.duplicate_bin: A bin with this name already exists.
error.duplicate_detector: Another entry already watches the same camera and region.
error.bin_retired: A retired bin with this name exists - use "Reactivate a retired bin" instead.
error.last_active_bin: The last active bin cannot be retired.

abort.already_configured: A detector for this camera and region is already configured.

data_description.confirm_scans: 1 = a clear detection switches immediately. Higher values require that many consecutive clear detections before a sensor changes state.

capture_snapshot.name: Capture calibration snapshot
capture_snapshot.description: Saves a camera frame into the calibration archive and returns its filename.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which detector instance (only needed with several).

add_sample.name: Add lid sample
add_sample.description: Marks a rectangle on a bin lid in an archived snapshot.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which detector instance (only needed with several).

bin.name: Bin
bin.description: Bin id (slug of the bin name).

rect.name: Rectangle
rect.description: [x, y, w, h] as relative coordinates.

space.name: Coordinate space
space.description: Whether the rectangle is relative to the full image or to the region of interest.

label_image.name: Label snapshot
label_image.description: Marks which bins are present or absent in an archived snapshot; relearns automatically.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which detector instance (only needed with several).

present.name: Present
present.description: List of bin ids visible in the image.

absent.name: Absent
absent.description: List of bin ids not in the image.

auto_relearn.name: Relearn automatically
auto_relearn.description: Recompute the profile right after labeling.

relearn.name: Relearn
relearn.description: Recomputes all thresholds from the calibration data.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which detector instance (only needed with several).

forget_image.name: Forget snapshot
forget_image.description: Removes a snapshot's samples and labels from the calibration data (the archived file is kept). Use this to recover from samples drawn on the wrong spot.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which detector instance (only needed with several).

restore_image.name: Restore image
restore_image.description: Puts a previously forgotten image back into training (forget_image never deletes, it only excludes).

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Config entry (optional with a single entry).

reconfirm_images.name: Re-confirm images
reconfirm_images.description: Re-asserts existing labels under the current region and view after a reconfiguration, without changing the labels. Only do this for images you have visually re-checked.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Config entry (optional with a single entry).

mark_bin_appearance_changed.name: Mark bin appearance changed
mark_bin_appearance_changed.description: The physical lid changed (for example the municipality swapped the color). Existing samples and present-labels of this bin go dormant but are kept; draw new samples and label fresh snapshots afterwards.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Config entry (optional with a single entry).

set_roi.name: Set region of interest
set_roi.description: Programmatic region edit (used by the calibration card). Behaves exactly like the reconfigure dialog: evidence is kept, the profile is relearned under the new region.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Config entry (optional with a single entry).

start_learning.name: Start learning run
start_learning.description: Declare the situation and let the system capture and learn on its own until the run is ended.

stop_learning.name: End learning run
stop_learning.description: Ends the run and clears the declared situation.

discard_auto_evidence.name: Set collected evidence aside
discard_auto_evidence.description: Takes everything the learning runs collected out of training. Nothing is deleted.

restore_auto_evidence.name: Bring collected evidence back
restore_auto_evidence.description: Returns previously set-aside evidence to training and lifts a pause.

relearn_failed.title: Relearn failed: {title}
relearn_failed.description:
The detection profile could not be relearned after the last change; detection keeps running on the previous profile and its old geometry. Reason: {error}

Fix the calibration (for example mark bins or confirm presence in the calibration card). The next successful relearn removes this issue automatically.
